description: A token inserted at the start of a constituent is at the start of the constituent's source, the least source start among its tokens (engine §1, §11). The second stage emits X[1,1) Y[0,0) Z[1,1) for `a` and X[2,2) Y[1,1) Z[2,2) for `b`, so X Y ends before it starts. So an inserted I before each triple is at 0 and then at 1, not at X's 1 and 2.

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (letter letter)
%rule letter char %emits $ :: A, $ :: A
%rule char "a" | "b"
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (pair pair)
%rule pair (prefix edge)
%rule prefix A %emits ε :: X
%rule edge ($n:nothing A) %emits ε :: Y, $n :: Z
%rule nothing ε
```

```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (triple triple)
%rule triple ($q:xy Z) %emits ε :: I, $q :: Q
%rule xy (X Y)
```
